title: Time, work and speed
description: Work rates, pipes and cisterns, man-days, and trains crossing poles and each other.

questions.prompt: A can finish a job in 12 days and B in 18 days. How long do they take working together?
questions.explanation: Add the rates: 1/12 + 1/18 = 3/36 + 2/36 = 5/36 of the job per day, so together they need 36/5 = 7.2 days.

questions.prompt: A and B together finish a job in 10 days. A alone takes 15 days. How long does B take alone?
questions.explanation: B's rate = 1/10 − 1/15 = 3/30 − 2/30 = 1/30, so B alone takes 30 days.

questions.prompt: 6 people build a wall in 8 days. How many days would 4 people take, working at the same rate?
questions.explanation: The wall is 6 × 8 = 48 person-days of work. 4 people need 48 / 4 = 12 days.

questions.prompt: Pipe A fills a tank in 4 hours. Pipe B empties the full tank in 6 hours. With both open, how long does an empty tank take to fill?
questions.explanation: Net rate = 1/4 − 1/6 = 3/12 − 2/12 = 1/12 of the tank per hour, so it fills in 12 hours.

questions.prompt: A works twice as fast as B. Together they finish a job in 8 days. How long would A take alone?
questions.explanation: Let B's rate be x and A's 2x. Then 3x = 1/8, so x = 1/24 and A's rate is 2/24 = 1/12: 12 days.

questions.prompt: 15 workers finish a project in 20 days, working 8 hours a day. How many days would 20 workers take, working 6 hours a day?
questions.explanation: Total work = 15 × 20 × 8 = 2,400 worker-hours. 20 workers × 6 hours = 120 worker-hours a day, so 2,400 / 120 = 20 days.

questions.prompt: A 300 m long train passes a pole in 15 seconds. What is its speed?
questions.explanation: Passing a pole, the train covers its own length: 300 / 15 = 20 m/s. Multiply by 18/5 to get km/h: 72 km/h.

questions.prompt: A can do a job in 10 days. A works for 4 days, then B finishes the rest in 9 days. How long would B take to do the whole job alone?
questions.explanation: In 4 days A does 4/10 of the job, leaving 6/10. B does 6/10 in 9 days, so the whole job takes B 9 / 0.6 = 15 days.

questions.prompt: Trains of 120 m and 180 m run towards each other at 40 km/h and 50 km/h. How long do they take to cross each other completely?
questions.explanation: Moving towards each other, the speeds add: 90 km/h = 25 m/s. They must cover both lengths, 300 m, so 300 / 25 = 12 seconds.

questions.prompt: A, B and C can do a job alone in 20, 30 and 60 days. How long do they take together?
